cards.example_en: I will remember that trip forever.
cards.example_zh: 我会永远记得那次旅行。

cards.example_en: I sometimes forget my lunch box on the kitchen counter.
cards.example_zh: 我有时会把饭盒忘在厨房的台面上。

cards.example_en: I dropped my fork under the table during lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭时我的叉子掉到了桌子底下。

cards.example_en: New students complete a form on their first morning.
cards.example_zh: 新生在开学第一个早晨填写一张表格。

cards.example_en: Please step forward.
cards.example_zh: 请向前走一步。

cards.example_en: Local families will found a music club next term.
cards.example_zh: 一些本地家庭下学期要创办一个音乐社团。

cards.example_en: A fox ran across the snowy field.
cards.example_zh: 一只狐狸跑过雪地。

cards.example_en: I was free after the club, so I helped tidy the art room.
cards.example_zh: 社团活动结束后我有空，就帮忙收拾了美术教室。

cards.example_en: The lake will freeze if it gets colder.
cards.example_zh: 再冷下去湖面就会结冰。

cards.example_en: Fresh strawberries were cheaper at the morning market.
cards.example_zh: 新鲜草莓在早市上更便宜。

cards.example_en: There's some milk in the fridge.
cards.example_zh: 冰箱里有一些牛奶。

cards.example_en: My friend shared her umbrella with me in the rain.
cards.example_zh: 下雨时，朋友和我合撑一把伞。

cards.example_en: A friendly librarian showed me where the atlases are kept.
cards.example_zh: 一位友好的图书管理员告诉我地图册放在哪里。

cards.example_en: Their friendship began in primary school.
cards.example_zh: 他们的友谊从小学开始。

cards.example_en: I got a letter from my friend.
cards.example_zh: 我收到了朋友的一封信。

cards.example_en: Please stand at the front of the line.
cards.example_zh: 请站到队伍前面。

cards.example_en: Ripe fruit from the market filled two large bowls.
cards.example_zh: 从市场买来的熟水果装满了两个大碗。

cards.example_en: The full kettle was too heavy for my little cousin to lift.
cards.example_zh: 满满的水壶太重，我的小表弟提不起来。

cards.example_en: Making dumplings together was great fun on New Year's Eve.
cards.example_zh: 除夕一起包饺子特别有乐趣。

cards.example_en: His funny drawing of the head teacher made everyone laugh.
cards.example_zh: 他把校长画得很滑稽，大家都笑了。

cards.example_en: She trains daily because her future is in nursing.
cards.example_zh: 她每天训练，因为她的未来是做护理。

cards.example_en: The board game kept us busy through a rainy afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 那个桌游让我们在下雨的下午忙个不停。

cards.example_en: Tomatoes are ripening in the garden beside the kitchen.
cards.example_zh: 西红柿正在厨房旁边的花园里渐渐成熟。

cards.example_en: I smelled gas and opened the kitchen windows at once.
cards.example_zh: 我闻到气体的味道，立刻打开了厨房的窗户。

cards.example_en: Parents waited outside the gate with coats and umbrellas.
cards.example_zh: 家长们拿着外套和雨伞在大门外等着。

cards.example_en: The general rule is to walk, not run, inside the corridors.
cards.example_zh: 总的规则是在走廊里走路，不要跑。

cards.example_en: The gentleman held the door for us.
cards.example_zh: 那位先生为我们扶住了门。

cards.example_en: We drew a map in geography class.
cards.example_zh: 地理课上我们画了一张地图。

cards.example_en: You get one point for each correct answer.
cards.example_zh: 每答对一题，你就得到一分。

cards.example_en: This watch was a gift from my uncle.
cards.example_zh: 这块手表是我叔叔送的礼物。

cards.example_en: The giraffe reached the top leaves.
cards.example_zh: 长颈鹿够到了树顶的叶子。

cards.example_en: A girl from Class Two won the city reading prize.
cards.example_zh: 二班的一个女孩获得了全市阅读奖。

cards.example_en: Please give me that red pen.
cards.example_zh: 请把那支红钢笔给我。

cards.example_en: I am glad the lost cat found its way back home.
cards.example_zh: 我很高兴那只走失的猫自己找到了回家的路。

cards.example_en: He knocked over a glass of juice at breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 早饭时他打翻了一杯果汁。

cards.example_en: Wear a glove when you catch the ball.
cards.example_zh: 接球时戴上手套。

cards.example_en: Use glue to stick the photo in the book.
cards.example_zh: 用胶水把照片贴进本子。

cards.example_en: We go to the library on Sundays.
cards.example_zh: 我们星期天去图书馆。

cards.example_en: Maya kicked the final goal just as the whistle blew.
cards.example_zh: 哨声响起时，玛雅踢进了最后一球。

cards.example_en: In that myth, a god sends rain to the dry valley.
cards.example_zh: 在那个神话里，一位神把雨送到干旱的山谷。

cards.example_en: Visitors can still see gold in the old mine museum.
cards.example_zh: 游客仍能在旧矿博物馆里看到黄金。

cards.example_en: This is a good place for a picnic.
cards.example_zh: 这是个野餐的好地方。

cards.example_en: She waved goodbye at the school gate.
cards.example_zh: 她在校门口挥手告别。

cards.example_en: The government opened a free clinic near the market.
cards.example_zh: 政府在市场附近开了一家免费诊所。

cards.example_en: He entered a higher grade after passing the summer test.
cards.example_zh: 他通过暑假测验后升入了更高的年级。

cards.example_en: A recent graduate came back to coach our debate team.
cards.example_zh: 一位刚毕业的学生回来指导我们的辩论队。

cards.example_en: This grammar point is new for us.
cards.example_zh: 这个语法点对我们来说是新的。

cards.example_en: My grandfather tells stories after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 爷爷晚饭后讲故事。

cards.example_en: My grandmother grows tomatoes on the balcony.
cards.example_zh: 奶奶在阳台上种西红柿。

cards.example_en: She washed a grape before eating it.
cards.example_zh: 她洗了一颗葡萄再吃。

word.example_en: She will put forward a new club rule.
word.example_zh: 她将提出一条新的社团规则。

word.example_en: They will bring the exam forward by a week.
word.example_zh: 他们将把考试提前一周。

word.example_en: I look forward to the winter holiday.
At the end they set the bird free.
Please be friendly to new students.
A dog sat in front of the gate.
The park is full of families on Sunday.
word.example_zh: 星期天公园里充满了家人。

word.example_en: Have fun at the music club.
In general, buses here are on time.
word.example_zh: 一般来说，这里的公交准时。

word.example_en: Get on the bus at the school gate.
What time do we get to the museum?
I get up at six on weekdays.
We get off at the next stop.
Take a map so you do not get lost.
Do not give in when the work is hard.
word.example_zh: 作业难的时候也别屈服。

word.example_en: Do not give up. Try one more time.
The flowers give off a sweet smell.
word.example_zh: 这些花发出甜甜的气味。

word.example_en: Please give out the worksheets.
We give away old clothes every spring.
word.example_zh: 每年春天我们捐赠旧衣服。

word.example_en: She does not go in for loud games.
word.example_zh: 她不爱好参加喧闹的游戏。

word.example_en: She has to go through the form again.
word.example_zh: 她得再仔细看一遍表格。

word.example_en: Anna is good at maths and music.
Vegetables are good for your health.
They do a good job on the group project.
word.example_zh: 他们的小组作业干得不错。

word.example_en: Have a good time at the zoo.
word.example_zh: 祝你在动物园过得愉快。
